outcome: Met need for emergency obstetric care (EmOC)
Institutional stillbirth and early neonatal death rates
cohort: Pregnant women and newborns in Mozambique
finding: While the availability of facilities providing the full range of emergency obstetric care decreased in Mozambique between 2007 and 2012, many other indicators related to obstetric care and outcomes showed improvement.
mod_finding: The decline in the availability of assisted vaginal delivery was a major factor in the decrease in the indicator of EmOC service availability.
